+        self,
+        api_key: str | None = None,
+        model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        timeout: float = 60.0,

+

+        \"\"\"
+        if not isinstance(prompt, str):
+            raise TypeError(\"prompt must be a string.\")
+
+        body = json.dumps(
+            {\"model\": self.model, \"input\": prompt, \"store\": False}
+        ).encode(\"utf-8\")
+        request = Request(
+            API_URL,
+            data=body,
+            headers={
+                \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self.api_key}\",
+                \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
+            },
+            method=\"POST\",
+        )
+
+        try:
+            with urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
+                response_body = response.read()
+        except HTTPError as exc:
+            raise OpenAIAPIError(
+                f\"OpenAI API returned HTTP {exc.code}.\"
+            ) from None
+        except URLError:
+            raise OpenAIAPIError(\"Could not connect to the OpenAI API.\") from None
+        except TimeoutError:
+            raise OpenAIAPIError(\"The OpenAI API request timed out.\") from None
+
+        try:
+            result: Any = json.loads(response_body)
+        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+            raise OpenAIAPIError(\"The OpenAI API returned invalid JSON.\") from None
+
+        text = result.get(\"output_text\") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
+        if isinstance(text, str):
+            return text
+
+        output = result.get(\"output\") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
+        if isinstance(output, list):
+            text_parts = [
+                item[\"text\"]
+                for item in output
+                if isinstance(item, dict)
+                and item.get(\"type\") == \"message\"
+                and isinstance(item.get(\"content\"), list)
+                for item in item[\"content\"]
+                if isinstance(item, dict)
+                and item.get(\"type\") == \"output_text\"
+                and isinstance(item.get(\"text\"), str)
+            ]
+            if text_parts:
+                return \"\".join(text_parts)
+
+        raise OpenAIAPIError(\"The OpenAI API response contained no output text.\")
+
+
+def send_prompt(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
+    api_key: str | None = None,
+    timeout: float = 60.0,
+) -> str:
+    \"\"\"Convenience function for sending a prompt and getting its text reply.\"\"\"
+    return OpenAIResponsesClient(
+        api_key=[REDACTED_SECRET]
+        model=model,
+        timeout=timeout,
+    ).send_prompt(prompt)
*** End Patch
